statement: Under the FLSA, covered non-exempt employees must be paid at least $7.25 an hour (29 U.S.C. § 206(a)(1)(C)) and at least one and one-half times their regular rate for hours over 40 in a workweek (29 U.S.C. § 207(a)(1)).
caveat: State and local minimum wages above the federal floor control where they apply, and startup employees are frequently misclassified as exempt. This repo does not classify employees or compute wages.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (law-map 2026-10-14); independent domain expert review pending
